hunks.baseline: “How dare you threaten someone else’s dis, dis… disciple Taekyung while this old man was away?”
hunks.sol: “How dare you threaten someone else’s dis, dis… Disciple Taekyung while this old man was away?”

hunks.sol: My tears dried up at once as I muttered in disbelief. Jeok Cheongang roared.

hunks.sol: “You’re louder, Old Master. You’re practically shouting ‘Disciple Taekyung’ from the center of the world.”

hunks.baseline: “Judging by the volume of your voice, you’ll live another ten years.”
hunks.sol: “Judging by that voice, you’ll live another ten years.”

hunks.sol: It was a good thing Mungyeong had used his internal energy to raise a qi barrier and keep the sound from escaping. Otherwise, people would have gathered around us long ago.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang’s face had turned bright red. Mungyeong clicked his tongue softly.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang’s face flushed bright red. Mungyeong quietly clicked his tongue.

hunks.baseline: “We merely had a brief conversation. What would this old man gain by threatening such a young pup?”
hunks.sol: “We merely had a brief conversation. What would this old man gain from threatening such a young pup?”

hunks.sol: “It’s true that we only talked, but he said he’d sink me to the bottom of the Yangtze if he didn’t like my answer.”

hunks.sol: “Would you look at this damned old man! You think you’ll get away with pulling something like this?”

hunks.baseline: “Opening one’s Middle Dantian in such a short time is impossible. Even the phrase ‘heavenly fortune’ cannot explain it.”
hunks.sol: “Opening one’s Middle Dantian in such a short time is impossible. Even heavenly fortune cannot explain it.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang looked back and forth between Mungyeong and me, then let out a quiet laugh.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang looked back and forth between Mungyeong and me, then let out a short laugh.

hunks.baseline: “That’s…”
hunks.sol: “That…”

hunks.baseline: Mungyeong was left speechless by Jeok Cheongang’s calm, utterly confident response. At that moment, Jeok Cheongang crooked a finger at me.
hunks.sol: Mungyeong was left speechless by Jeok Cheongang’s calm, utterly confident response. Jeok Cheongang crooked a finger at me.

hunks.baseline: “You asked me to watch your training, didn’t you? We’re starting now.”
hunks.sol: “You asked me to oversee your training, didn’t you? We’re starting now.”

hunks.baseline: The situation had moved on so smoothly that even I was caught off guard. As though he had read my thoughts, Jeok Cheongang asked,
hunks.sol: The situation moved on so smoothly that even I was caught off guard. As though he had read my thoughts, Jeok Cheongang asked,

hunks.baseline: “…Well, judging by what that guy over there said, it might have been.”
hunks.sol: “…Well, judging by what that guy over there said, maybe.”

hunks.baseline: “You gained a fortuitous encounter. It seems the heavens are helping you. Strange things that no one could ever imagine do happen in this world.”
hunks.sol: “You gained a fortuitous encounter. It seems the heavens are helping you. Things beyond human understanding do happen in this world from time to time.”

hunks.baseline: After tossing out that single remark as though he wanted Mungyeong to hear it, Jeok Cheongang suddenly swung his wrinkled hand.
hunks.sol: After tossing out that remark for Mungyeong to hear, Jeok Cheongang suddenly swung his wrinkled hand.

hunks.baseline: “I felt like hitting you because you were irritating. Got a problem with that?”
hunks.sol: “You irritated me, so I felt like hitting you. Got a problem with that?”

hunks.baseline: “You blockheaded brat. What are you whining about? Stop fooling around and follow me.”
hunks.sol: “You blockheaded brat. Quit whining. Stop fooling around and follow me.”

hunks.baseline: I glanced at Mungyeong, who stood there with a strange expression that revealed nothing. A thunderous shout immediately crashed down on me.
hunks.sol: I glanced at Mungyeong, who stood there wearing an unreadable expression. A thunderous shout immediately crashed down on me.

hunks.baseline: “And yet this brat!”
hunks.sol: “You’re still dawdling!”

hunks.baseline: I turned my back on Mungyeong and followed close behind Jeok Cheongang, whispering,
hunks.sol: I turned my back on Mungyeong and hurried after Jeok Cheongang, whispering,

hunks.baseline: “Ask about what?”
hunks.sol: “About what?”

hunks.baseline: “If I catch you looking like this again, I’ll teach you a lesson. Understand?”
hunks.sol: “If I catch you in a situation like this again, I’ll teach you a lesson. Understand?”

hunks.baseline: “Quiet. I was about to smash everything to pieces earlier, but I held myself back.”
hunks.sol: “Quiet. I nearly smashed everything to pieces earlier, but I held myself back.”

hunks.baseline: “True. We should take Senior Mu Song’s circumstances into consideration. Did you see his face when we boarded the fast ship?”
hunks.sol: “True. We should take Senior Mu Song’s circumstances into consideration. Did you see his face when we boarded the swift ship?”

hunks.baseline: “What kind of nonsense are you talking about? Why should this old man care about the circumstances of those river bandits?”
hunks.sol: “What kind of nonsense are you talking about? Why should this old man care about those river bandits’ circumstances?”

hunks.sol: “If we lose another ship here, we’ll have to move everyone aboard to a different one. All that extra weight would slow us down.”

hunks.baseline: I watched the Fire Pokémon walk away, shivering from head to toe, when a thought suddenly occurred to me.
hunks.sol: I watched the Fire Pokémon walk away, shuddering from head to toe, when a thought suddenly occurred to me.

hunks.baseline: I ignored Mungyeong’s prickling gaze on the back of my head as best I could and followed Jeok Cheongang.
hunks.sol: I did my best to ignore Mungyeong’s prickling gaze on the back of my head as I followed Jeok Cheongang.

hunks.baseline: The fast ship cut through the water without slowing.
hunks.sol: The swift ship cut through the water without slowing.

hunks.baseline: Boats that saw the flag of the Yangtze River Channel League flying high above the deck hurriedly cleared a path. Even the government warships connected to the League through their sticky ties of collusion were no exception.
hunks.sol: Every vessel that saw the flag of the Yangtze River Channel League flying high above the deck hurriedly cleared a path. Even the government warships with their cozy ties to the League were no exception.

hunks.baseline: The river bandits knew the lower Yangtze and its waterways like the backs of their hands. Following Mu Song’s orders, they pulled hard on their oars, while the sails billowed wide in the wind blowing from far away.
hunks.sol: The river bandits knew the lower reaches of the Yangtze and all its waterways like the backs of their hands. Following Mu Song’s orders, they pulled hard on their oars while the sails billowed in the wind.

hunks.baseline: Like the rough waters of the Yangtze, the hours of that day flowed by quickly.
hunks.sol: Like the churning waters of the Yangtze, the hours of that day rushed past.

hunks.baseline: Just as he had the previous night, Mungyeong sat at the bow, gazing out at the Yangtze shrouded in darkness. When the uninvited guest who had come to see him again arrived, Mungyeong spoke in a low voice.
hunks.sol: Just as he had the previous night, Mungyeong sat at the bow and gazed out at the Yangtze shrouded in darkness. When his uninvited guest arrived again, he spoke in a low voice.

hunks.baseline: “It took time to find the liquor that fellow Mu Song—or whatever his name is—had hidden away. He fought to keep it from me until the very end.”
hunks.sol: “It took time to find the liquor that fellow Mu Song—or whatever his name is—had hidden away. He fought tooth and nail to keep it from me until the very end.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang perched himself on the railing and broke the seal on a small jar he had taken out as carefully as though it were a treasured family heirloom.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang perched on the railing and broke the seal on a small jar he had taken out as carefully as though it were a treasured family heirloom.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, the fragrant scent of liquor spread through the air. A crack appeared in Mungyeong’s usually expressionless face.
hunks.sol: A fragrant aroma of liquor immediately spread through the air, cracking Mungyeong’s usually impassive expression.

hunks.baseline: “Of course it’s Jiannan Chun when you come to Sichuan. This is what makes the trip worthwhile.”
hunks.sol: “Of course. When you come to Sichuan, you drink Jiannan Chun. This is what makes the trip worthwhile.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang lifted the jar to his mouth and gulped down the liquor. Then he smacked his lips.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang lifted the jar to his mouth and gulped down the liquor, then smacked his lips.

hunks.baseline: Mungyeong watched the jar of Jiannan Chun closely, then shook his head.
hunks.sol: Mungyeong stared intently at the jar of Jiannan Chun, then shook his head.

hunks.baseline: “Your answer was too slow. For an old man known as the greatest assassin in history, you make your thoughts awfully easy to read.”
hunks.sol: “You took too long to answer. For an old man known as the greatest assassin in history, you make your thoughts awfully easy to read.”

hunks.baseline: “I’d like to dispense with the nonsense and get to the point. You have something to say to me, don’t you?”
hunks.sol: “Enough nonsense. Let’s get to the point. You have something to say to me, don’t you?”

hunks.baseline: “Then call yourself a killer of lives.”
hunks.sol: “Then call yourself a life-taker.”

hunks.baseline: “Disciple and Master alike. Your words and actions are exactly the same.”
hunks.sol: “Like Disciple, like Master. You even talk the same.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang ignored Mungyeong’s frown, took another drink, and wiped his mouth with his sleeve before answering.
hunks.sol: Ignoring Mungyeong’s frown, Jeok Cheongang took another drink and wiped his mouth with his sleeve before answering.

hunks.baseline: “Our words and actions may resemble each other, but we’re worlds apart. That brat is a monster who has strayed beyond all common sense.”
hunks.sol: “We may talk alike, but we’re worlds apart. That brat is a monster who defies all common sense.”

hunks.baseline: He couldn’t disagree with the word *monster*. Reaching the Supreme Peak realm just after passing the age of twenty was astonishing enough, but Jin Taekyung had taken another step before he had even caught his breath.
hunks.sol: He couldn’t disagree with the word *monster*. Reaching the Supreme Peak realm just after turning twenty was astonishing enough, but Jin Taekyung had taken another step before he had even caught his breath.

hunks.baseline: *When did he reach the Supreme Peak realm?*
hunks.sol: *When did I reach the Supreme Peak realm?*

hunks.baseline: Mungyeong searched through memories of the distant past.
hunks.sol: Mungyeong searched his memories of the distant past.

hunks.sol: He had been younger then—sharper and quieter than he was now. He had devoted his heart and soul entirely to martial arts.

hunks.baseline: Sometimes covertly and sometimes through direct confrontation, he had accumulated experience through countless real battles. At last, he had set foot in that exalted realm that only the chosen could enter.
hunks.sol: Sometimes covertly and sometimes through direct confrontation, he had accumulated experience through countless real battles. At last, he had set foot in that exalted realm said to admit only the chosen.

hunks.baseline: *It was sometime in my mid-thirties.*
hunks.sol: *I was in my mid-thirties.*

hunks.baseline: Even Mungyeong, who had been called the greatest assassin in history and given the name Slaughter Saint, had not reached the Supreme Peak realm until after turning thirty.
hunks.sol: Even Mungyeong, hailed as the greatest assassin in history and known as the Slaughter Saint, had not reached the Supreme Peak realm until after turning thirty.

hunks.baseline: And he had opened his Middle Dantian several years later, when he was nearing forty.
hunks.sol: He had opened his Middle Dantian several years later, when he was nearing forty.

hunks.baseline: Yet Jin Taekyung had left his mark on Murim’s long history just after passing the age of twenty.
hunks.sol: Yet Jin Taekyung had left his mark on Murim’s long history when he was barely past twenty.

hunks.baseline: In Mungyeong’s estimation, this could only be the work of demonic, heterodox arts—and a legendary demonic martial art at that.
hunks.sol: In Mungyeong’s estimation, this could only be the work of demonic, heterodox arts—and an unparalleled demonic martial art at that.

hunks.baseline: “No, it’ll be over quickly. This old man doesn’t have much to say, either.”
hunks.sol: “No, it’ll be over quickly. This old man doesn’t have much to say.”

hunks.baseline: Mungyeong’s gaze sank deeply at Jeok Cheongang’s answer.
hunks.sol: Mungyeong’s gaze darkened at Jeok Cheongang’s answer.

hunks.baseline: “What can I say about something I’ve never seen or heard? There’s nothing to do but accept it.”
hunks.sol: “What can I say about something I’ve never seen or heard of? There’s nothing to do but accept it.”

hunks.baseline: “Surely you don’t believe the nonsense that the Sword Immortal Lü Dongbin appeared in his dream and gave him enlightenment.”
hunks.sol: “Surely you don’t believe that nonsense about the Sword Immortal Lü Dongbin appearing in his dream and granting him enlightenment.”

hunks.baseline: “It may have happened, or it may not have. But even if it’s true, it isn’t all that surprising. Heh heh.”
hunks.sol: “It may have happened, or it may not have. But even if it’s true, it wouldn’t be all that surprising. Heh heh.”

hunks.baseline: But the anger that had flashed across Mungyeong’s face vanished as though it had been washed away by Jeok Cheongang’s next words.
hunks.sol: But the anger that flashed across Mungyeong’s face vanished without a trace at Jeok Cheongang’s next words.

hunks.baseline: “It took that brat only two years to break through the wall of the Supreme Peak realm and open his Middle Dantian. If this old man were Lü Dongbin, I would have come to him in person—not in a dream—saying, ‘There’s an incredible fellow in the lower world.’”
hunks.sol: “It took that brat only two years to break through the wall of the Supreme Peak realm and open his Middle Dantian. If this old man were Lü Dongbin, I would have come to him in person instead of appearing in a dream, saying, ‘What an incredible fellow there is in the lower world.’”

hunks.baseline: But the small old man before him continued speaking with eyes clearer and more transparent than ever.
hunks.sol: But the small old man before him continued speaking, his eyes clearer than Mungyeong had ever seen them.

hunks.baseline: “Taekyung. That boy and the Sword Saint’s Disciple are, in the truest sense, divine dragons. No one has ever seen one. All anyone can do is guess.”
hunks.sol: “Taekyung. That boy and the Sword Saint’s Disciple are Divine Dragons in the truest sense. No one has ever seen one. All anyone can do is imagine what they must be like.”

hunks.baseline: “That’s impossible. Every part of it.”
hunks.sol: “Every part of that is impossible.”

hunks.baseline: “There’s one truth this old man learned while growing older for no reason. You can’t control another person’s heart.”
hunks.sol: “There’s one truth this old man learned while growing older for no good reason. You can’t control another person’s heart.”

hunks.baseline: And it was only on the day he sincerely accepted a young man he had met by chance deep into his heart that he suddenly realized something else.
hunks.sol: And only after he met a young man by chance and, one day, truly accepted him into his heart did he realize something else.

hunks.baseline: The pain that throbbed whenever he thought of that day had grown fainter.
hunks.sol: The pain that throbbed whenever he remembered that day had grown faint.

hunks.baseline: “You’ll understand if you watch him. Just as I did.”
hunks.sol: “You’ll understand if you keep watching him. Just as I did.”

hunks.sol: Mungyeong silently watched Jeok Cheongang’s back as he rose from the railing and ambled away. Then he suddenly spoke.

hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang turned and laughed heartily beneath the moonlight.
